name: the language bodies speak
source:
two forms fumble together in the dark, their minds don't know the words but their bodies do

[From [url=https://basicbean.itch.io/mouth-fingers-rain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个身影在黑暗中摸索，他们的头脑不知道这些话，但他们的身体知道
